_comment: Curated name->address map for the proposal decoder. Covers addresses that are NOT hardhat-deploy artifacts: governance origins and runtime-created money-market proxies (aTokens / GHO facilitator tokens whose addresses are minted on-chain by the PoolConfigurator, never written to a deployment JSON). Asset-id precompiles and substrate pallet accounts are resolved generically by the decoder and do not belong here. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
